answer: Because the pulse graph is rebuilt each epoch, the garden merge is applied at settlement and the oasis audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet thus collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Identities funded from a common source within 35 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
